visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Nighttime on a sandy beach. A woman with long black hair, wearing a sleeveless floral dress, walks towards the camera with a bright smile. Large white Chinese characters are superimposed on the screen. Behind her, a white fabric canopy is illuminated by warm string lights, creating a cozy atmosphere. (2) The woman explores the dining area. A small table is set for two with white tablecloths and glassware inside a tent-like structure made of white poles and draped fabric. Yellow fairy lights are scattered on the surrounding sand, outlining a path. (3) She sits inside the lit tent, posing gracefully. A pink-colored cocktail sits on the table in front of her. She wears a relaxed expression, looking at the camera. The background is dark, showing the vast beach and distant lights of the resort. (4) Daytime scene transition. The woman is seated at the same beach table under the white canopy. She smiles and covers her face playfully. Green palm trees and resort buildings are visible in the bright, natural light of late afternoon. (5) Close-up shots of gourmet dishes. First, a bright green soup served in a white bowl. Second, a scoop of green sorbet in a silver bowl topped with a small red flower. Finally, thick chocolate sauce is poured over a dark chocolate sphere.
